The animated viewBox path has source-derived function-first composed sweeps and explicit unknown retention, validated by doc 166's all-platform gate.

Pseudo shorthand filter functions are exact native-vector effects with function-list, mutation, clip/transform/stack-slot, zoom, and DPR evidence. Blend arithmetic, URL filter graphs outside their documented reference/convolution routes, and several backdrop source-surface transitions remain partial.
